name: Sampling Design & Survey Methodology
description: Principles of multi-stage stratified probability sampling, circular systematic sampling, sampling frames (Urban Frame Survey - UFS, Census enumeration blocks), and estimation in large-scale sample surveys (NSS, PLFS, ASUSE).

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Identifies basic sampling terminology (SRS, stratified sampling, cluster sampling) and components of a sample frame.
behavioralIndicators: Can define sample frame and sampling unit
Understands difference between probability and purposive sampling

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Applies standard sampling selection methods (random number tables, circular systematic sampling) for primary sampling units (PSUs).
behavioralIndicators: Executes circular systematic selection of households in CAPI
Accurately calculates sampling intervals

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Executes multi-stage stratified survey designs, calculates multipliers and sample weights, and handles non-response adjustments.
behavioralIndicators: Computes design weights for PPSWR and SRSWOR
Formulates post-stratification weight adjustments

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Formulates custom sampling designs for complex socio-economic surveys, optimizes sample allocation across strata, and minimizes design effects.
behavioralIndicators: Optimizes Neyman allocation across survey strata
Models design effects (deff) in multi-stage surveys

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Designs national sampling frameworks, evaluates frame degradation, and advises the National Statistical Commission on survey methodologies.
behavioralIndicators: Directs national sampling master frame redesign
Advises international bodies on survey methodology

name: National Accounts Statistics & SUT Compilation
description: System of National Accounts (SNA 2008), gross domestic product (GDP), gross value added (GVA) by economic activity, Supply and Use Tables (SUT), and Sequence of Accounts.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Understands macro-economic aggregates (GDP, GVA, NNI) and the distinction between constant and current prices.
behavioralIndicators: Explains nominal vs real GDP
Differentiates factor cost, basic prices, and market prices

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Compiles sector-specific GVA for standard industries using direct reporting statements and administrative data.
behavioralIndicators: Extracts corporate financial data for manufacturing GVA
Calculates intermediate consumption ratios

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Constructs Input-Output balance tables, applies double deflation methods, and reconciles production vs expenditure accounts.
behavioralIndicators: Implements double deflation on manufacturing and trade
Reconciles discrepancies in GDP expenditure components

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Develops comprehensive Supply and Use Tables (SUT), estimates Financial Intermediation Services Indirectly Measured (FISIM), and models informal sector contribution.
behavioralIndicators: Constructs 140x140 product by industry SUT matrix
Estimates FISIM allocation across institutional sectors

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Directs national base-year revision exercises, implements SNA updates, and represents India at UN Expert Group meetings on National Accounts.
behavioralIndicators: Leads national base year revision for National Accounts
Authored official methodological manuals on SNA

name: Index Numbers & Price Statistics (CPI, IIP, WPI)
description: Compilation methodologies for Consumer Price Index (CPI-Rural/Urban/Combined), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), Wholesale Price Index (WPI), Laspeyres, Paasche, and Fisher formulas, and chain-linking.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Explains concepts of base year, price relative, basket of goods, and Laspeyres index formula.
behavioralIndicators: Understands weighting diagrams and elementary price relatives
Knows current CPI base year and group classifications

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Scrutinizes monthly price quotations collected from urban/rural markets; verifies item substitutions.
behavioralIndicators: Validates field price schedules from selected market centers
Handles temporary specification changes in representative items

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Calculates item-level, sub-group, and group indices; handles seasonal item imputations and missing price quotes.
behavioralIndicators: Applies geometric mean for elementary aggregates
Implements carry-forward and cell-mean imputation for missing price quotes

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Formulates index weighting diagrams from Household Consumer Expenditure Survey (HCES) data; implements chain-base methodology.
behavioralIndicators: Derives state-level CPI weights from CES microdata
Builds chain-linked IIP series bridging revisions

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Spearheads national price index revisions, quality adjustments (hedonic pricing), and harmonization with IMF/ILO standards.
behavioralIndicators: Chairs technical advisory committee on price statistics
Standardizes scanner data ingestion for national CPI

name: Industrial & Enterprise Statistics (ASI & Economic Census)
description: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) framework, National Industrial Classification (NIC-2008), factory registration frame, capital structure, input-output ratios, and Economic Census.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Understands definitions of factory, fixed capital, working capital, gross output, and net value added under ASI.
behavioralIndicators: Identifies scope under Factories Act 1948 Sections 2m(i) and 2m(ii)
Knows basic NIC 2-digit and 3-digit classifications

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Canvasses ASI schedule Part-I and Part-II; validates balance sheet entries against audited financial statements.
behavioralIndicators: Inspects factory profit & loss statements against canvassed schedule
Scrutinizes energy consumption and raw material blocks

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Resolves unit-level non-response; performs block-level data scrutiny and consistency checks across capital and output accounts.
behavioralIndicators: Identifies negative value added anomalies and investigates causes
Applies multiplier weighting across census and sample sectors

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Synthesizes annual industrial summary reports; links ASI microdata with MCA-21 database for corporate enterprise analytics.
behavioralIndicators: Integrates ASI survey frames with Ministry of Corporate Affairs data
Models capital-labor substitution in Indian manufacturing

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Formulates national industrial survey policies, updates NIC classification codes, and modernizes enterprise statistical frameworks.
behavioralIndicators: Authors the national industrial statistics manual
Leads the design and execution of nationwide Economic Censuses

name: Applied Probability & Inferential Estimation
description: Probability distributions, asymptotic theory, variance estimation for complex survey designs (Jackknife, Balanced Repeated Replication - BRR, Linearization), and weight calibration.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Explains standard error, confidence intervals, p-values, and basic probability distributions.
behavioralIndicators: Understands central limit theorem in survey context
Identifies normal, binomial, and Poisson distributions

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Calculates standard errors and confidence intervals for simple random samples and standard stratified estimators.
behavioralIndicators: Computes standard errors for sample means and proportions
Performs hypothesis testing on survey sub-groups

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Computes design-based standard errors using Taylor series linearization or bootstrap methods for survey estimates.
behavioralIndicators: Estimates variance for ratio estimators in multi-stage surveys
Implements Jackknife replication for complex indicators

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Implements Generalized Regression (GREG) estimation and calibration estimators using auxiliary administrative totals.
behavioralIndicators: Calibrates survey weights using rake algorithm against Census totals
Develops empirical best linear unbiased predictors (EBLUP)

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Researches and develops novel Small Area Estimation (SAE) models to produce reliable district-level official indicators.
behavioralIndicators: Publishes peer-reviewed methodologies on official survey estimation
Architects national SAE framework for disaggregated SDG metrics

name: Time Series Analysis & Seasonal Adjustment
description: Stochastic processes, ARIMA/SARIMA modeling, trend-cycle decomposition, seasonal adjustment using X-13ARIMA-SEATS, and economic forecasting.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Identifies components of a time series: trend, seasonality, cyclical, and irregular variations.
behavioralIndicators: Distinguishes between additive and multiplicative time series models
Understands quarterly and monthly seasonality patterns

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Plots time series data, performs moving averages, and checks for basic stationarity (unit root tests).
behavioralIndicators: Conducts Augmented Dickey-Fuller tests in statistical software
Computes moving average smoothers for monthly indicators

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Estimates ARIMA/SARIMA models and generates baseline short-term forecasts for key economic indicators.
behavioralIndicators: Diagnoses ACF and PACF plots for model identification
Forecasts monthly inflation and industrial production indices

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Executes robust seasonal adjustment on monthly/quarterly series (IIP, CPI, GDP) using X-13ARIMA-SEATS protocols.
behavioralIndicators: Configures regARIMA models with trading day and holiday effects
Evaluates spectral diagnostic tests for residual seasonality

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Establishes official seasonal adjustment standards for the National Statistical System and models structural macroeconomic breaks.
behavioralIndicators: Formulates the national policy for official seasonally adjusted releases
Leads econometric modeling of structural macroeconomic shocks

name: Demographic & Social Statistics (PLFS & SDG Framework)
description: Labour force metrics (UPSS, CWS, LFPR, WPR, UR), poverty metrics, health/education indicators, and SDG National Indicator Framework (NIF) monitoring.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Understands basic labour force concepts (Usual Principal & Subsidiary Status, Current Weekly Status) and SDG terminology.
behavioralIndicators: Defines LFPR, WPR, and Unemployment Rate according to NSS concepts
Recognizes the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Canvasses PLFS household and person schedules; calculates elementary labour force participation rates.
behavioralIndicators: Canvasses 7-day activity recall matrices accurately in CAPI
Calculates youth unemployment rates across states

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Generates quarterly and annual PLFS bulletin tables; tracks SDG baseline vs current milestone performance.
behavioralIndicators: Produces standard PLFS tabulation tables with statistical error bands
Updates the SDG National Indicator Framework dashboard

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Evaluates structural shifts in informal employment, gender wage differentials, and multidimensional deprivation indices.
behavioralIndicators: Models transitions across employment statuses using longitudinal PLFS panels
Analyzes time-use survey data for unpaid care work quantification

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Formulates national social statistics monitoring frameworks and guides inter-agency SDG data alignment with UN agencies.
behavioralIndicators: Directs national social indicator strategy with NITI Aayog
Represents India at the UN Statistical Commission on Social Statistics

name: Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA & EnviStats)
description: System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA-Central Framework & Ecosystem Accounting), natural capital accounting, and energy/water balance statistics.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Defines basic environmental indicators (greenhouse emissions, forest cover, ambient air quality metrics).
behavioralIndicators: Understands relationship between economic activity and environmental degradation
Identifies primary national environmental data sources

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Compiles physical supply and use tables for energy and water from administrative reports.
behavioralIndicators: Extracts state-level mineral and forest extraction statistics
Compiles basic energy balance accounts

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Formulates land cover and asset accounts; models ecosystem condition metrics in accordance with SEEA guidelines.
behavioralIndicators: Constructs physical asset accounts for forest and water resources
Maps ecosystem extent using satellite land cover classifications

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Conducts economic valuation of ecosystem services and produces EnviStats India annual publications.
behavioralIndicators: Applies hedonic pricing and travel cost methods for ecosystem valuation
Drafts comprehensive chapters for EnviStats India

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Integrates Green GDP and natural capital degradation metrics into the core National Accounts framework.
behavioralIndicators: Architects India's SEEA Ecosystem Accounting master framework
Leads international technical discussions on natural capital accounting

name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics
description: Data wrangling (dplyr, data.table), survey data analysis (survey, srvyr), SDMX connectors (rsdmx), and automated reporting (rmarkdown, knitr).

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Executes basic R scripts, loads CSV/RData datasets, and runs summary statistics (summary(), table()).
behavioralIndicators: Loads data frames and examines column types in R
Calculates basic unweighted summaries

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Cleans and transforms unit-level survey data using tidyverse verbs; generates basic exploratory charts (ggplot2).
behavioralIndicators: Performs filter, mutate, group_by operations on survey records
Generates publication-quality histograms and scatter plots

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Configures complex survey designs using the survey package to produce weighted tabulations and standard errors.
behavioralIndicators: Constructs svydesign objects incorporating stratification and clustering
Computes svymean and svyby with design-based standard errors

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Develops modular R packages and reusable data processing pipelines for high-volume survey microdata.
behavioralIndicators: Authors internal R packages with roxygen2 documentation
Automates survey bulletin compilation with RMarkdown / Quarto

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Architects official R-based statistical infrastructure and mentors national analysts in reproducible analytical pipelines (RAP).
behavioralIndicators: Sets coding and quality standards for all R-based official statistics pipelines
Leads reproducible analytical pipeline modernization across NSO

name: Python for Data Engineering & Official Statistical Analytics
description: Microdata processing (pandas, polars), numerical modeling (numpy, scipy, statsmodels), automated ETL, and API integration (FastAPI).

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Writes elementary Python scripts, loads tabular data with pandas, and executes basic data inspections.
behavioralIndicators: Reads CSV/Parquet files and checks shape, info, and nulls
Writes basic conditional loops and functions

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Performs automated data cleaning, merges multiple administrative files, and exports standardized datasets.
behavioralIndicators: Executes joins, merges, and pivot tables across survey schedules
Cleans string anomalies and standardizes date/code fields

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Implements automated ETL workflows, data validation pipelines, and time-series models using statsmodels.
behavioralIndicators: Builds automated ETL scripts connecting raw CAPI exports to analytical tables
Fits ARIMA and regression models using statsmodels

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Builds scalable data pipelines utilizing polars / Dask for processing multi-gigabyte census and enterprise datasets.
behavioralIndicators: Optimizes memory and execution using lazy evaluation in Polars
Deploys FastAPI services for internal microdata querying

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Deploys machine learning algorithms (automated industrial classification) into production statistical pipelines.
behavioralIndicators: Architects scalable cloud data pipelines for pan-India surveys
Directs AI/ML model governance and accuracy benchmarks

name: Relational Database Management & Complex SQL
description: Relational schema design, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, complex analytical queries (window functions, CTEs), and indexing strategies for massive statistical datasets.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Writes basic SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY queries on single tables.
behavioralIndicators: Filters and sorts survey establishment records
Calculates basic column aggregations (COUNT, SUM, AVG)

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Performs multi-table JOIN operations, GROUP BY aggregations, and subqueries on survey databases.
behavioralIndicators: Joins household and person level tables using composite primary keys
Computes division-wise summaries with HAVING clauses

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Writes advanced SQL using Common Table Expressions (CTEs), window functions (ROW_NUMBER(), RANK()), and stored procedures.
behavioralIndicators: Uses partition by window functions for historical trend calculations
Develops stored procedures for automated data ingestion checks

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Optimizes query execution plans, configures table partitioning, and manages high-availability statistical data warehouses.
behavioralIndicators: Analyzes EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution trees to optimize complex queries
Implements table partitioning strategies for multi-year survey data

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Architects the enterprise relational and dimensional data warehouse architecture for MoSPI/DIID.
behavioralIndicators: Designs the national statistical warehouse star/snowflake schema
Ensures enterprise ACID compliance and disaster recovery protocols

name: Computer Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) & Digital Capture
description: Development and deployment of CAPI applications using CSPro, Blaise, or custom web/mobile platforms; skip logic, validation rules, and offline data synchronization.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Operates CAPI mobile/tablet software for canvassing survey schedules in the field.
behavioralIndicators: Navigates tablet survey interface during household interview
Performs daily local synchronization of canvassed schedules

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Identifies validation error prompts in CAPI apps and resolves data entry inconsistencies during respondent interviews.
behavioralIndicators: Interprets soft and hard edit warnings during field interviews
Corrects typographical data errors in respondent presence

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Tests and debugs CAPI survey instruments; configures complex routing logic, rosters, and range checks.
behavioralIndicators: Validates skip logic and conditional roster loops before field rollout
Extracts field paradata (time stamps, GPS coordinates)

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Authors complete CAPI survey applications (CSPro logic/Blaise code), including audio audit and GPS capture features.
behavioralIndicators: Programs complex multi-module survey schedules in CSPro/Blaise
Configures server-side data reconciliation endpoints

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Directs the national transition to digital survey capture architectures and standardizes multi-mode data collection (CAPI/CATI/CAWI).
behavioralIndicators: Architects next-generation digital data collection standards for India
Leads global technical consultations on mobile survey platforms

name: Automated Microdata Scrutiny, Validation & Imputation
description: Deterministic and probabilistic validation rules, out-of-range checks, logical consistency matrix, and item imputation methods (Hot-deck, Cold-deck, KNN, Multiple Imputation).

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Detects obvious outliers and missing fields during manual or basic programmatic scrutiny of survey schedules.
behavioralIndicators: Flags missing required fields in canvassed schedules
Identifies impossible demographic relationships (e.g. child age > parent)

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Applies pre-programmed validation rulebooks to flag inconsistent records in survey microdata.
behavioralIndicators: Executes automated batch scrutiny scripts on regional data submissions
Categorizes errors into warning vs fatal classification

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Formulates mathematical validation rules (using tools like R-validate); executes donor hot-deck imputations.
behavioralIndicators: Programs comprehensive validation rulesets across survey blocks
Executes nearest-neighbor hot-deck imputation on item non-response

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Implements automated Fellegi-Holt editing systems and multi-variate predictive mean matching for complex surveys.
behavioralIndicators: Implements error localization models minimizing field changes
Conducts sensitivity analysis on alternative imputation regimes

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Establishes national data scrutiny protocols, error tolerances, and benchmark imputation standards across all statistical divisions.
behavioralIndicators: Authors the national microdata editing and imputation guidelines
Certifies final microdata quality prior to public release

name: Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange (SDMX)
description: SDMX 2.1/3.0 architecture, Data Structure Definitions (DSD), Concept Schemes, Codelists, Dataflows, and automated data exchange with international agencies (UN, IMF, World Bank).

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Explains the purpose of SDMX in standardizing statistical data and metadata exchange.
behavioralIndicators: Identifies benefits of SDMX over unstructured spreadsheet exchanges
Understands SDMX concepts of dimensions and attributes

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Validates SDMX-ML or SDMX-JSON datasets against published DSDs using standard registry tools.
behavioralIndicators: Uses SDMX matrix browser to inspect dataset structures
Validates indicator payloads against official codelists

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Authors and maintains DSDs, Codelists, and Concept Schemes for national indicators.
behavioralIndicators: Builds national DSDs for SDG indicators using SDMX tools
Maps internal database fields to international SDMX structures

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Configures SDMX REST APIs and automated data mapping between internal databases and SDMX dissemination endpoints.
behavioralIndicators: Deploys SDMX web services powering real-time data exchange
Configures dataflow provisioning with international agencies

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Represents MoSPI on the International SDMX Working Group and leads the national implementation of the SDMX global registry.
behavioralIndicators: Directs the national SDMX architecture implementation across all ministries
Contributes to global SDMX technical standard specifications

name: Geospatial Analytics & GIS Integration for Official Statistics
description: Geographic Information Systems (GIS), spatial sampling frames (UFS digitization), QGIS/ArcGIS, GeoJSON, spatial autocorrelation, and thematic statistical mapping.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Reads thematic maps and understands basic spatial data concepts (coordinates, layers, shapefiles).
behavioralIndicators: Interprets district-level statistical choropleth maps
Understands latitude/longitude coordinates and GPS accuracy

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Generates district-level choropleth maps from tabular statistical outputs using QGIS.
behavioralIndicators: Joins tabular survey indicators to administrative boundary shapefiles
Applies standard cartographic classification schemes

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Performs spatial joins between survey enumeration blocks and socio-economic microdata; validates UFS digital boundaries.
behavioralIndicators: Digitizes and audits Urban Frame Survey (UFS) block boundaries
Performs point-in-polygon aggregations for spatial microdata

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Conducts spatial econometric modeling (spatial lag/error models) and builds interactive web-GIS dashboards (Leaflet/Mapbox).
behavioralIndicators: Computes Moran's I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA)
Develops responsive web mapping applications for official data

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Directs the integration of the National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI) with the National Statistical Registry.
behavioralIndicators: Architects the national geospatial-statistical data integration framework
Leads UN-GGIM (Global Geospatial Information Management) initiatives

name: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) & Quality Assurance
description: Application of IMF/UN/MoSPI Data Quality Assessment Frameworks; evaluation of integrity, methodological soundness, accuracy, reliability, serviceability, and accessibility.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Identifies the core dimensions of statistical data quality (timeliness, accuracy, relevance, accessibility).
behavioralIndicators: Understands why data quality matters in official policy formulation
Recognizes key quality metrics in survey releases

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Implements standard data quality checklists during data entry and initial compilation stages.
behavioralIndicators: Applies division quality checklist to newly processed datasets
Documents deviations from standard data collection protocols

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Conducts formal DQAF assessments on survey datasets and calculates response rates and sampling errors.
behavioralIndicators: Evaluates statistical outputs across all 5 IMF DQAF dimensions
Computes item non-response rates and coefficients of variation

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Establishes division-wide Quality Assurance Guidelines (QAG) and leads quality audit missions across field units.
behavioralIndicators: Authors division-specific quality assurance guidelines
Directs supervisory quality audit teams for national surveys

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Authors the National Quality Assurance Framework (NQAF) for the Indian Statistical System.
behavioralIndicators: Formulates the national statistical quality framework
Represents India in international quality evaluation peer reviews

name: Statistical Disclosure Control & Microdata Anonymization
description: Disclosure risk assessment, k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, perturbation methods (noise addition, micro-aggregation, data swapping), and differential privacy.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Identifies direct identifiers (name, address, Aadhaar) and understands the requirement to strip PII from public datasets.
behavioralIndicators: Knows what constitutes personally identifiable information (PII)
Ensures raw respondent identities are stripped prior to sharing

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Applies global recoding and top/bottom coding to indirect identifiers (age, district, income brackets).
behavioralIndicators: Implements top-coding on extreme income and wealth observations
Recodes detailed 5-digit geographical codes into broader regional bands

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Uses tools like sdcMicro to measure re-identification risk and implement k-anonymity on survey microdata files.
behavioralIndicators: Calculates sample and population individual disclosure risks
Executes k-anonymity (k>=5) and l-diversity algorithms on survey datasets

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Designs anonymization protocols for complex longitudinal and hierarchical datasets balancing privacy risk and analytical utility.
behavioralIndicators: Evaluates information loss metrics after micro-aggregation and noise addition
Formulates anonymization pipelines for linked household-enterprise data

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Formulates the official MoSPI Microdata Dissemination & Anonymization Policy adhering to the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.
behavioralIndicators: Authors national statistical privacy and dissemination regulations
Leads the adoption of differential privacy for official statistical products

name: Metadata Standards & National Statistical Registries
description: Data Documentation Initiative (DDI-Codebook/Lifecycle), Dublin Core, ISO/IEC 11179 metadata registries, and statistical classification standards.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Understands the distinction between data and metadata; identifies basic metadata components (survey description, schedule).
behavioralIndicators: Explains why structured documentation is critical for statistical reuse
Identifies survey title, round, and variable names in documentation

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Populates standard survey metadata templates conforming to DDI specifications for NSS rounds.
behavioralIndicators: Fills out standard study-level and file-level metadata templates
Maintains variable code dictionaries with complete value labels

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Builds and validates complete DDI XML/JSON metadata packages including variable-level definitions and value labels.
behavioralIndicators: Authors DDI-compliant XML documentation packages using Nesstar Publisher
Validates schema conformity of statistical metadata files

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Integrates statistical metadata registries with the National Data Governance Framework (NDGF).
behavioralIndicators: Builds searchable central metadata catalogs for cross-division discovery
Maps national statistical definitions to ISO/IEC 11179 registries

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Leads national metadata architecture harmonization and establishes pan-government metadata interoperability standards.
behavioralIndicators: Authors the national statistical metadata mandate for all central ministries
Chairs the national metadata governance council

name: Official Statistics Ethics & Legal Frameworks
description: UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics (UN-FPOS), Collection of Statistics Act 2008 & Rules 2011, professional independence, and statistical confidentiality.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Understands the legal obligation of respondents to provide data under the Collection of Statistics Act.
behavioralIndicators: Knows statutory powers of statistical officers under the 2008 Act
Recognizes legal duty to maintain absolute respondent confidentiality

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Adheres strictly to respondent confidentiality protocols and ethical field conduct during data collection.
behavioralIndicators: Secures physical and digital schedules against unauthorized disclosure
Explains statutory protections to reluctant survey respondents

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Resolves legal compliance issues and non-response notices under the Collection of Statistics Act provisions.
behavioralIndicators: Issues statutory compliance notices for industrial establishment non-response
Enforces data protection safeguards during third-party data processing

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Evaluates statistical processes against the 10 UN-FPOS principles and enforces institutional safeguards against data tampering.
behavioralIndicators: Conducts ethical audits of statistical workflows
Defends professional independence in methodology and release timing

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Formulates legislative amendments to official statistics acts and defends statistical independence at national forums.
behavioralIndicators: Drafts national statistical legislation and statutory rules
Safeguards the legal and ethical integrity of the National Statistical System

name: Open Government Data Dissemination & API Stewardship
description: Open Data standards (machine-readability, open formats, open licenses), data.gov.in integration, NSO Data Portal, and RESTful API management.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Identifies open data file formats (CSV, JSON) versus proprietary formats; understands open data portals.
behavioralIndicators: Understands why open non-proprietary formats promote transparency
Navigates the national open data portal data.gov.in

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Prepares tabular data in open formats with standard documentation for public dissemination.
behavioralIndicators: Converts raw proprietary tabulations into machine-readable CSVs
Formats clean headers without merged cells for automated parsing

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Configures datasets on the NSO Open Data Portal with proper licensing, tags, and data dictionary attachments.
behavioralIndicators: Publishes survey datasets with granular metadata and Open Government Data License
Monitors dataset downloads and public user feedback

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Designs and deploys public API endpoints for programmatic access to official time series and macro indicators.
behavioralIndicators: Implements OpenAPI/Swagger documented endpoints for CPI/IIP indicators
Sets up rate-limiting and cache headers for public dissemination APIs

rubrics.label: Expert
rubrics.description: Champions national open data policy reforms and establishes automated cross-ministry data sharing protocols.
behavioralIndicators: Authors the national open statistical data strategy
Directs pan-government API federation for official statistics

name: Information Security & Cyber Hygiene in Statistical Infrastructure
description: ISO/IEC 27001 standards, CERT-In guidelines, role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end data encryption, and secure cloud statistical operations.

rubrics.label: Basic
rubrics.description: Practices strong password hygiene, two-factor authentication, and safe handling of institutional credentials.
behavioralIndicators: Uses multi-factor authentication on all official portals
Recognizes phishing and social engineering attempts

rubrics.label: Novice
rubrics.description: Applies encryption to microdata files at rest and in transit; enforces device security on field CAPI tablets.
behavioralIndicators: Encrypts sensitive survey microdata using AES-256 tools
Ensures tablet remote wipe and lock features are activated

rubrics.label: Proficient
rubrics.description: Implements Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) and audits user access logs on statistical processing servers.
behavioralIndicators: Configures granular database permissions based on official job cadre
Reviews and audits server access logs for anomalous downloads

rubrics.label: Advanced
rubrics.description: Formulates disaster recovery and business continuity plans for critical national statistical registries.
behavioralIndicators: Conducts threat modeling and vulnerability scans on survey applications
